## HN discussion (2 comments)

- [other] BElluu: I do not know why, but it's so laggy on my PC in chrome. When I cut some ink or do some chaotic moves it's more than 1000ms Presentation delay
- [author] georgestrakhov: yes, definitely some optimizations are due if you go beyond 20-30 moves or move fast. would love a PR on that if anyone cares!

{"decision": "pass", "reason": "无障碍快照能看出这是一个带墨色、Blow、Hair、Drift 等工具的交互式墨流模拟器，但证据里没有说明它的实现机制或相对常见做法的具体差异，作者评论也只承认大量笔画时卡顿，没有可复用的洞见。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason cites tools that appear in the accessibility snapshot (ink colors, Blow, Hair, Drift). It correctly says the page gives no implementation details, and it accurately describes the author's admission that the app lags beyond 20-30 moves. It argues the post lacks a novel insight, which supports the pass decision.
